description: This file defines a JavaScript module for a sortable list component, including class definitions, methods for drag-and-drop functionality, event handling, and utility functions.

classes.name: Sortable
classes.description: Main class implementing sortable list behavior with methods for initialization, event handling, sorting, and destruction.

methods.name: _onTapStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag operation, setting up necessary state and event bindings.

methods.name: _prepareDragStart
methods.description: Prepares the element for dragging, including setting timers for delayed drag start.

methods.name: _disableDelayedDrag
methods.description: Cancels any pending delayed drag start.

methods.name: _triggerDragStart
methods.description: Triggers the actual drag start event, supporting touch and fallback modes.

methods.name: _dragStarted
methods.description: Marks the drag as started, applying visual effects and setting active sortable.

methods.name: _emulateDragOver
methods.description: Simulates drag over events for touch devices.

methods.name: _onDragOver
methods.description: Handles the drag over event, managing element repositioning and auto-scrolling.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Animates the movement of elements during sorting.

methods.name: _offUpEvents
methods.description: Removes event listeners related to drag end and cancel.

methods.name: _onDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event, finalizing the sorting and cleaning up state.

methods.name: _nulling
methods.description: Resets all internal variables and state after drag operation.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Main event handler dispatching to specific methods based on event type.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the current order of items into an array of identifiers.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Reorders items according to a given array of IDs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current sorting state via the store option.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor matching a selector.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Gets or sets options for the sortable instance.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cleans up the instance.
